findings.text: non-blocking: Station.tick calls station_obligations.publish before self.store.heartbeat(now=moment) at :214, so the first publish of a station's life reads no heartbeat row and writes "heartbeat": null, and on a restart it reads the pre-stop beat; export_snapshot's 90 s carried-beat gate (station_obligations.py:288) then refuses to rewrite, so the exported file reports stale=True for up to 90 s after start, which is the confusion the heartbeat exists to prevent. The tests miss it because their _station helper writes the heartbeat before exporting (tests/test_obligations_read_the_station.py:139), unlike the production order.

non-blocking: test_the_station_root_is_the_session_hosts_root asserts station_runtime_candidate(environ, run_user_root) == station_store.runtime_root_source(environ, run_user_root), but obligation_snapshot.py:291 now returns runtime_root_source's own result, so the two sides of the assertion call the same function with the same arguments and it can never fail; the docstring at :178-185 still calls the resolver a copy, which the delegation removed.

item_verdicts.call_sites: Verified four production call sites: reckon/crew/station.py:207, reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py:1030 and :1292, and reckon/mcp_views.py:4044.

item_verdicts.done_when: Plan §9's done-when names an equal answer on a fixture fleet, a stale heartbeat reported with its age, and no new snapshot over 60 s plus a negative control; tests/test_obligations_read_the_station.py:213, :229 and :261 assert those, logs/gate-head.log ends 10 passed with EXIT=0, logs/gate-base.log ends 1 error with EXIT=2 because the new module cannot be imported at base, and logs/negative-control.log records three mutations each ending 1 failed with EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal asks that the obligations hook and `crew view obligations` read the station's per-session obligations, with a throttled snapshot for readers off the node; the hook reads first at reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py:1030 and :1292, the view reads first at reckon/mcp_views.py:4044, and reckon/crew/station.py:207 exports the snapshot through station_obligations.publish, so all three halves of the goal are present.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read in full; it names six commits (d9001681c, efa4d1237, 87c64846b, 9d1c9bd94, 7c62c7486, 7778eecd3), the literal gate command, seven log paths, the baseline and after suite arms, three negative-control mutations and their notes, and no outside-scope work.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The reviewed manifest lists eight declared paths; git diff 20e65d881..7778eecd3 touches seven files (the figures directory is unused) and every one is inside the declared list.

justifications.durability: tests/test_obligations_read_the_station.py:294 reddens when a live station freezes its carried beat, :261 reddens when the export never writes, :340 when a changed fleet does not rewrite, :229 when a stale beat serves duties, and :417 when the view derives instead of reading; only :195 is vacuous because station_runtime_candidate delegates to the store it compares against.
justifications.evidence: logs/gate-head.log ends 10 passed with EXIT=0 at head and logs/negative-control.log records three mutations red at EXIT=1, but every export case drives station_obligations.export_snapshot directly rather than through Station.tick, so the method the production path calls is never exercised.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/station_obligations.py names no plan, sprint or ticket identifier and follows the surrounding module idiom, but tests/test_obligations_read_the_station.py:178-185 still describes a copied candidate order that 7c62c7486 replaced with a delegation.
justifications.goal_fidelity: Both consumers the goal names are wired: the hook at reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py:1030 and the view at reckon/mcp_views.py:4044 both read obligation_snapshot.read_station_answer before falling back, and reckon/crew/station.py:207 exports the throttled snapshot.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:283 now delegates station_runtime_candidate to station_store.runtime_root_source and :303 asks station_store.DATABASE_NAME, while station_obligations.py reuses payload_for, document_for, fleet_state and write_atomically, so no capability is forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in git diff 20e65d881..7778eecd3 is inside the eight declared write paths, and nothing outside them was touched.
